artworks.title: Oedipus at Colonus
artworks.description: Harriet's blind king in the Attic grove — the suppliant whom Apollodorus says Theseus received at Colonus, and Pausanias remembered with a monument whose bones were brought from Thebes.

artworks.title: Oedipus and Antigone
artworks.description: Jalabert paints the daughter who alone followed the cast-out Labdacid — the companion Apollodorus names on the road from Thebes to Colonus in Attica.
